# Hairline

> An engraved chart library for React. Each chart takes one JSON-serialisable payload that a zod schema validates, so an agent can pick a chart by the job it does, write the data to its shape and check it before rendering. The package is not yet on npm.

## Choosing and checking a chart

- The registry (`registry` and `getChart(kind)` from `@howells/hairline/schema`, React-free) lists every chart's `kind`, `component`, Visual Vocabulary `jobs`, `dataShape`, `limits`, `whenToUse` and `whenNotToUse`.
- `getChart(kind).validate(payload)` returns the typed data or path-specific issues. Dates are ISO strings; formatters are descriptors (`"percent"` or Intl number-format options); a datum is addressed by `id`, else its label or date.
- Data is required. The package never falls back to demo data.
- For a server-rendered or exported chart pass `width` and `height`: a fixed-size chart is drawn and ready in the first HTML unless it asks for `animate: "scroll"` or `"mount"`.

## Charts

- [DumbbellQueue](https://hairline.danielhowells.com/#/docs/dumbbell-queue): kind `dumbbell-queue`, import `@howells/hairline/dumbbell-queue`, JSON Schema `@howells/hairline/json-schema/dumbbell-queue.json`. Jobs: deviation, change-over-time. The same few things measured at two moments, or against a target: how far each moved, and which way.
- [HairlineArea](https://hairline.danielhowells.com/#/docs/hairline-area): kind `hairline-area`, import `@howells/hairline/hairline-area`, JSON Schema `@howells/hairline/json-schema/hairline-area.json`. Jobs: change-over-time, magnitude. One quantity measured every day over weeks to a year, where the volume under the line is the story: daylight, sales, traffic.
- [HairlineLine](https://hairline.danielhowells.com/#/docs/hairline-line): kind `hairline-line`, import `@howells/hairline/hairline-line`, JSON Schema `@howells/hairline/json-schema/hairline-line.json`. Jobs: change-over-time, ranking. One quantity read every day for a few weeks, where each day is worth a dot and the peak or trough is the point: a price, a temperature.
- [PlumbScatter](https://hairline.danielhowells.com/#/docs/plumb-scatter): kind `plumb-scatter`, import `@howells/hairline/plumb-scatter`, JSON Schema `@howells/hairline/json-schema/plumb-scatter.json`. Jobs: correlation, ranking. A dozen or so named things measured on two quantities, to show whether they move together and which stand apart.
- [RungBars](https://hairline.danielhowells.com/#/docs/rung-bars): kind `rung-bars`, import `@howells/hairline/rung-bars`, JSON Schema `@howells/hairline/json-schema/rung-bars.json`. Jobs: magnitude, ranking. A handful of counts the reader can tally by eye: years against events, one number per category.
- [Slope](https://hairline.danielhowells.com/#/docs/slope): kind `slope`, import `@howells/hairline/slope`, JSON Schema `@howells/hairline/json-schema/slope.json`. Jobs: change-over-time, ranking. The change between two points for a handful of rows: before and after, this year against last, where the reader should see which rose and which fell.

## Docs

- [Philosophy](https://github.com/howells/hairline/blob/main/docs/PHILOSOPHY.md): what is fixed, what is configurable.
- [Data](https://github.com/howells/hairline/blob/main/docs/DATA.md): the contract every payload follows.
- [README](https://github.com/howells/hairline/blob/main/README.md): install, theming, server and export modes.
- JSON Schemas: `@howells/hairline/json-schema/index.json` lists every kind and its schema file; `pnpm build:lib` writes them into `lib/json-schema/`.
